name: LED bar (R36S / XF35H handhelds)
description: Shows the party's health on the handheld's LED bar: green while it is healthy, lilac in the middle, red breathing when it is low and red blinking when a knockout is close; the bar's own rotating mode when the party is out. ONLY WORKS ON THE RK3326 HANDHELDS (R36S, XF35H and their clones): it talks to the console's LED controller, which other machines do not have. Off, nothing changes. On, it starts a small helper (ledd, installed by the handheld menu) that owns the bar, raises its power in battle and drops it when the battle ends or the game goes away.
